business_problem: BBVA wanted to scale safe, responsible generative AI across the bank so frontline and specialist teams could solve knowledge-heavy tasks faster, including answering high volumes of client legal questions, accelerating company credit analysis from many document sources, and extracting insight from large volumes of customer feedback.
solution_summary: BBVA rolled out ChatGPT Enterprise across the organization and used it as the shared generative AI platform for employees to build task-specific GPTs. The implementation distributed 3,000 enterprise licenses and allowed teams across countries to create custom assistants close to their business processes. Within that environment, BBVA published around 700 reusable GPTs in its internal BBVA GPT Store. Concrete implementations include the Retail Banking Legal Assistant GPT, which uses documentation maintained by a nine-lawyer advisory team to answer client legal questions routed through branch managers; the Credit Analysis Pro GPT, which pulls relevant information from annual reports, sustainability evaluations, and media documentation to support credit risk assessments; and the Client Experience Assistant GPT in Mexico, which processes thousands of satisfaction surveys to generate conclusions and improvement actions for customer service. BBVA also embedded legal, compliance, and IT security oversight into adoption.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
solution_components.role: Provides the bank-wide generative AI platform where employees use and build custom GPTs for operational tasks.

solution_components.name: BBVA GPT Store
solution_components.role: Distributes reusable GPTs internally so users across the organization can access high-interest assistants.

solution_components.name: Retail Banking Legal Assistant GPT
solution_components.role: Uses the advisory team's documentation to help answer client legal questions received through branch managers.

solution_components.name: Credit Analysis Pro GPT
solution_components.role: Extracts relevant company data from multiple document sources and compares companies with sector peers for credit analysts.

solution_components.name: Client Experience Assistant GPT
solution_components.role: Processes satisfaction survey data to summarize conclusions and recommend actions to improve customer service.

data_flow: Legal documentation from BBVA's advisory team is used by the Retail Banking Legal Assistant GPT to answer client questions for branch managers; annual reports, sustainability evaluations, and media documentation feed Credit Analysis Pro GPT for analyst review; satisfaction surveys feed Client Experience Assistant GPT for service-improvement recommendations. These GPTs are built and accessed through ChatGPT Enterprise, with many shared through BBVA GPT Store.
business_outcome: BBVA achieved broad internal adoption of generative AI, with most licensed users incorporating it into weekly work, thousands of custom GPTs created, faster legal responses for clients, quicker credit-analysis preparation, and improved ability to derive customer-service insights from survey data.
